title: Lapis Philosophicus (PH436)
shelf_note: No tradition or collection given in the packet; the pages are a Latin alchemical florilegium (Hermes, Bonellus, Clangor, Rasis, Albertus Magnus, 'Sententiæ'), so the book would fit an alchemy shelf.
structure_note: No structure counts in the packet. The written page numbers line up with the scan positions at a fixed offset (scan 51 = p. 43, 101 = p. 93, 151 = p. 143), so the pagination runs straight through this stretch. All three pages have a transcription and none has a translation.

book_verdict: The three transcriptions are close to perfect against a clear humanist-italic manuscript hand. Later pencil cross-references are tagged as margin text, and headings and catchwords are caught. The only slips are accent and spelling normalisations. No page has a translation, so this book reads as Latin only.
